title: NQR Summer Custom Quarter ZOO-DH
wikitext:
[[Image:nqr-summer.jpg|right|NQR Summercup Logo]] == Introduction == * Competition: [[NQR Summer Custom Cup]] * Round: Quarterfinals * Match: [[Eläintarha]] vs [[Dutch Hope]] * Date: 12-07-2004 == Screenshots == === SKTEAM === [[Image:NQR_Summer_Custom_Quarter_DH-ZOO_SKTeam.jpg]]

We agreed to play on thursday in first instantion, though JKova came to me and said that they weren't able to field a team. Because they weren't able to play on friday and saturday, and we couldn't play on sunday the only option left was wednesday. It turned out that they were still one man short and they offered to give WO but we decided that one of us would spectate and we'd play 3on3. Our map choice was Skteam, we had to win our own map because we knew how good they are on cmt3. That's why we picked this map, we hoped they didn't know it, and it turned out that way. We were able to lock them quite early even though they gave a good fight later they didn't get closer.

=== CMT3 === [[Image:NQR_Summer_Custom_Quarter_DH-ZOO_cmt3.jpg]]

Their map, we feared them bigtime here and when they got the first Pent and RL it looked like they would rape us big time. Though we got a takeover and after that they couldn't harm us anymore. GG's even though there was some trouble.

''Report by [[Purity]]''
